needs.proposedSignature: Effect: { op: 'must-attack'; target: TargetSpec | Ref | 'creatures-you-control'; defender?: 'that-player' | 'each-opponent'; duration: 'eot' | 'this-combat' }  and StaticEffect: { kind: 'attacks-if-able'; scope: 'self' | 'you-control'; filter?: Filter; defender?: 'that-player' }
needs.semantics: Adds an attack REQUIREMENT (CR 508.1a / 506.4) to objects the effect names, optionally naming which player they must attack. Today `mustAttack` is only read off a permanent's PRINTED static abilities (game.ts:2384), so no effect can impose it on a token it just created. Needed by encore's token copies ('attacks that opponent this turn if able') and by Legion Warboss's Goblin token ('attacks this combat if able'); goad (keyword-action) is the same machinery one step further.
needs.clause: That token gains haste until end of turn and attacks this combat if able.

needs.proposedSignature: AbilityCost part is already there (exileSelfFromGraveyard); what is missing is Effect: { op: 'encore' } — or, compositionally, `{ op: 'token-copy', target: 'self', count: { count: 'opponents' }, attacking: 'each-opponent', mustAttack: true }`
needs.semantics: '{cost}, Exile this card from your graveyard: For each opponent, create a token copy of this card that attacks that opponent this turn if able. They gain haste. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step. Activate only as a sorcery.' Everything but the attack requirement and the per-opponent attack assignment composes today (activated + fromGraveyard + token-copy + grant-keyword haste + delayed-trigger next-end-step + remove-those). `token-copy.attacking` is honoured only during declare-attackers, and encore is sorcery-speed, so the tokens must be given a standing requirement instead.
